outcome: Differential expression of circular RNAs (circRNAs) in the placenta
cohort: 45 Pregnant women undergoing cesarean section (30 with GDM and 15 without GDM)
finding: RNA sequencing analysis revealed 46 differentially expressed circRNAs in the placentas of women with GDM compared to those without, suggesting their potential involvement in the development and progression of GDM.
